issue.author: stranske
issue.body:
## Why (verified evidence)
The capability's situation exists in the Brain and nothing consumes it.
- `outcomes`, 90 days: 71 rows where `verifier_verdict` ≠ `adjudicated_verdict` — 57 NON_PASS vs merged PASS (39 codex, 14 cursor, 4 claude; all `source=keepalive`, Sep–Oct), 9 FAIL_HOLLOW vs FAIL, 5 others — settled by the rule "merged means PASS" (`src/outcomes.py:310-317`).
- `src/roles.py:2475-2488` — `run_adjudicator_agent(case=..., ground_truth_evidence=..., dispatch=True)`; `src/roles.py:842-845` the case needs `target`, `disputed_finding`, `ground_truth_evidence`; output `uphold_blocker | reject_blocker | needs_more_evidence` (`:739-751`).
- `src/capability_advisor.py:1172-1174` — bound only to `implementation-verification`, consulted before any blocker is seen (4 declines: "no contested blocker exists"); `:1119-1139` the closer-lane binding has no adjudicator; `src/tick.py:506-529` the tick path is dry-run since 2026-09-03 and needs two differing verdicts a dry run never carries.
- Its one real case (Fine-Art-Archive #612, 2026-08-30) matched an independent call.
Consequence: 71 real contested cases and zero adjudications.

## Tasks
- [ ] `src/adjudicator_retro.py` (new, or a subcommand of `roles.py`) — build a case packet per persisted dispute: `disputed_finding` = the verifier decision comment (`src/verifier_evidence.py`), `ground_truth_evidence` = the merged diff summary and the gate run; run `run_adjudicator_agent` in shadow (router-chosen backend), record each verdict in the Brain as a role run with `source=retrospective`, never changing an outcome.
- [ ] Compare each verdict with later ground truth (`outcomes.durability`, revert or broke-later signals from `fleet_shapes`) and write `$ORCH_STATE_DIR/capability-program/adjudicator-retro.json`: agreement rate vs the "merged means PASS" rule, cost per case, counts.
- [ ] `src/capability_advisor.py:1119-1139` — bind `role-adjudicator` on `closer-lane` with a precondition `requires_pr: contested_verdict` (verifier verdict present and ≠ merge disposition) so it is offered only at a real dispute.
- [ ] `src/switch_review.py` — one line: `adjudicator shadow: cases N, agree A, disagree D, cost C`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Named test: `tests/test_adjudicator_retro.py::test_packet_builder_needs_target_finding_and_ground_truth`, `::test_retro_records_verdicts_without_changing_outcomes`, `::test_closer_lane_offers_the_adjudicator_only_on_a_contested_verdict`.
- Deliberate-break → revert: let the retro write to `outcomes` → second test FAILS; offer without a contested verdict → third FAILS; revert.

## Non-Goals
- Do NOT act on any verdict (no label, no merge, no comment).
- Do NOT re-enable the tick's adjudicator path.
- No scaffolding / TODO-only changes; every task is a concrete edit verified by the gate above.
- Do NOT edit `~/.codex` automation prompts or `orchestrate.sh` defaults unless a task names the line; the binding is data, never prose.

_Surfaced by the 2026-10-04 capability audit (`Code/Audits/Orchestrator/2026-10-04-rarely-used-capabilities-audit.md`, program `2026-10-04-capability-program.md`); every line below was read on `main` c88282b on 2026-10-04. Part of the Capability Program 2026-10._
